results.description: TSX-V-listed Awalé Resources has finalised its private placement financing agreement with gold production and development company Predictive Discovery and mid-tier precious metals producer Fortuna Mining, securing funds that will mainly go toward exploration at its wholly-owned Odienné project, in Côte d'Ivoire.
